cautions.en: No public pricing page exists; the official site directs prospects to book a demo and request a quote.

capabilities.en: Markerless motion capture using a multi-camera setup, without physical suits or markers, powered by a patented AI motion engine.
Cloud-based Move One platform with scalable capture volumes and claimed data quality comparable to traditional optical mocap.
Integration with Unreal Engine for direct use of captured motion data in production pipelines.

limitations.en: No self-serve pricing; access requires booking a demo and going through a sales process.
Targeted at studio-scale production (VFX, gaming, entertainment) with named enterprise clients (Ubisoft, Disney, Sony), suggesting a cost structure not aimed at solo freelancers.

reason.en: Alternative animation/production tool also used in VFX and game pipelines.
Free option for 3D animation, though without markerless motion capture hardware/AI pipeline.

unknowns: No pricing tiers, trial terms, or currency published anywhere on the official site; all commercial terms are behind a sales/demo process.
